description: This file provides localization (i18n) strings for the Select2 library version 4.0.6-rc.1 for the Estonian language, defining messages for input constraints, loading status, and search results.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns a message indicating the user has entered too many characters and shows how many to remove.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns a message indicating the user has entered too few characters and shows how many more to type.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns a message indicating that more results are being loaded.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Returns a message indicating the maximum number of selections allowed.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Returns a message indicating that no search results were found.

methods.name: searching
methods.description: Returns a message indicating that a search is in progress.
